objective: Determine when CAV-report-based RSU coordination offers incremental benefit over a fixed external damping controller, at any traffic state.

scope.runtime_input: received timestamped CAV self states and onboard detections only

characterization.note: Small development panels, not statistical acceptance. Seed IDs are already exposed and never become prospective. All loads use the same seeds; demand is not measured density.

geometry_capture.scope: Read-only geometry capture; band and 50m formed definition are hypotheses for the wall study, not accepted defaults.

benefit_definition.form: at least one preregistered primary physical improvement, subject to all declared cost guardrails

cost_units.braking_seconds_per_request: vehicle-seconds below -3 m/s2 per requested vehicle
cost_units.effort_per_request: integral squared acceleration per requested vehicle

benefit_definition.numerical_margins_status: must be specified with units and rationale before opening wall outcomes; no accepted defaults
benefit_definition.failed_attempts: retained in paired benefit evaluation and also receive separate formation labels

stages.title: Controller identity, command ownership and replay
tests: Exact frozen model and raw SI singleton inference.
Correct absolute command, physics clock, native fallback, HDV isolation and return to identical damping.
Real branch prefix/replay and zero-effect sham before interpreting wall outcomes.
stages.deliverable: Test log plus bounded physical replay/sham evidence for the eventual wall runner.
stages.advance_rule: Implementation and comparison identities pass. Damping need not beat IDM.

stages.title: CAV acquisition, report receipt and missingness
tests: Sensor range/lane boundaries, nearest-visible detection, occlusion, noise and missed detections.
Timestamp, receipt, stale/late/duplicate packets, unknown space and missing lanes.
Hidden simulation changes cannot change identical report-based features or gates.
Reporting CAV counts and overlapping sensor coverage never become a true traffic census.
stages.deliverable: Frozen sensor/communication contract and report provenance.
stages.advance_rule: Every online field is acquirable and unknown information leads to explicit abstention. Ideal-sensor tests do not claim real-sensor robustness.

stages.title: Characterize fixed damping and capture opportunities across traffic states
tests: Same exposed seeds at both initial loads, paired native and damping, unchanged controller.
Record full requested service, source waiting, unfinished trips, braking, effort, TTC, collisions and teleports.
Record measured lane density, speed distribution and stopped counts in a separate offline channel.
Keep free-flow, oscillating and congested states; no congestion trigger or efficacy pass condition.
stages.deliverable: Bounded paired characterization and timestamped CAV reports reusable by geometry and wall selection.
stages.advance_rule: Complete interpretable data and correct implementation. A weak or strong damping result both advance. Do not retrain or manufacture poor performance.

stages.title: Initial separation, convergence and physical feasibility
tests: Candidate separation 10,25,49,50,51,75,100,150 m; declared final compactness provisionally 50 m.
Cross-lane speed mismatch 0,1,2,4 m/s; safe front/rear room and upstream runway.
Distinguish already-compact speed settling from convergence of spatially dispersed members.
Measure actual readiness, initial/max/final span, speed convergence, compact HOLD, abort and refusal.
Test cut-ins, member lane change/loss, missing reports, deadline and release-boundary exhaustion.
stages.deliverable: Observed geometry-to-delivery map; independent formation labels from measured trajectories.
stages.advance_rule: A reproducible formation mechanism exists in declared scope. A hardcoded 50 m rejection is not an empirical physical boundary. Synthetic trajectories are not SUMO evidence.

stages.title: Wall authority, HOLD and release
tests: Freeze one report-based target rule, authority limits, assembly, HOLD, taper and hard abort before outcomes.
Compare few declared one-factor variants only when diagnosing a specific failure; no full Cartesian search.
Maintain declared lane coverage and compactness, observe actual acceleration rather than command alone.
Normal taper, hard abort, follower compression and delayed postrelease harm.
Use sham and assembly-only ablations when attribution is ambiguous, reusing exact compatible evidence.
stages.deliverable: One frozen wall profile and a verified integrated damping/wall runner.
stages.advance_rule: Treatment delivery and safety/service are measured. No claim that a short smooth command proves safe traffic outcomes.

stages.title: Incremental physical benefit in any traffic state
tests: Match continued damping and attempted wall for the same seed, proposal, starting state and exogenous future.
Evaluate assembly plus HOLD, release and delayed effects at a common service horizon.
Use explicit primary improvement margins and guardrails for all other costs; no required congestion state.
Include failed assembly, harmful, neutral and helpful attempts; report intent-to-treat and delivery separately.
Preserve native IDM as a context reference, without requiring damping to dominate it.
stages.deliverable: Verified paired physical effects and a wall-benefit decision, conditional on the declared scope.
stages.advance_rule: Useful repeatable incremental benefit exists under preregistered margins. If all admissible cases help equally, retain a simple rule; do not manufacture negative labels to justify learning.

stages.title: Penetration, formation availability and observation availability
tests: 5%,10%,20%,30%, nested CAV identities and identical exogenous requests.
Report all decision opportunities, suitable membership, sufficient information, approvals, attempts, formation success and completed effects.
Separate insufficient members, unsafe geometry, insufficient information and insufficient expected benefit.
Do not impose a low-penetration failure or use true penetration as an online feature.
stages.deliverable: Availability/effect results by penetration and measured traffic-state strata with honest denominators.
stages.advance_rule: Coverage of the declared scope and refusal mechanisms is documented; no requirement that every low-penetration case fails.

stages.title: Dataset integrity and observation sufficiency
tests: Same proposal, predecision evidence and matched outcome horizon for each label.
CAV self/local reports and histories only; no global health, true density, hidden driver types, future outcomes or episode IDs as model features.
Seed-level training, calibration and prospective split plus archived exposure audit.
Current observations versus history, coverage and age features; simple report-based rules as first baseline.
Keep formation failures and declined opportunities distinct; no future selection or complete-case outcome filtering.
stages.deliverable: Versioned paired dataset, feature acquisition map, split registry and sufficiency report.
stages.advance_rule: Label integrity and out-of-seed information value are established; an offline oracle is diagnosis only, never a runtime feature.

stages.title: Feasibility gate reliability
tests: Predicted deliverability versus measured safe formation and declared HOLD delivery.
False approval, false rejection and missing-information abstention by penetration, separation and report quality.
Transparent geometry/kinematic rule first; learn only if it adds held-out value.
Calibrate any predicted probabilities using separate calibration episodes.
stages.deliverable: Frozen feasibility rule/model and its operating-point error rates.
stages.advance_rule: Reliability meets preregistered requirements with uncertainty. Predicting a programmed threshold is not proof of physical feasibility.

stages.title: Incremental benefit gate and operating threshold
tests: Rule baseline versus small learned predictor using the same acquired evidence and wall proposal.
False escalations, missed beneficial opportunities, abstention, Brier/reliability and policy value.
Benefit in uncongested as well as congested states; density alone never requires an intervention.
Fix physical benefit margins and decision threshold on development/calibration only.
stages.deliverable: Frozen benefit predictor or sufficient analytical rule plus calibration record.
stages.advance_rule: Out-of-seed decision value supports the gate; training accuracy alone cannot advance the paper claim.

stages.title: Both gates and repeated decisions in the full controller
tests: Both approvals bind the same proposal and current report snapshot; either rejection returns damping.
One active wall, cooldown, fresh reauthorization, no duplicate command ownership or rapid toggling.
Loss of observation/member, hard abort and identical damping re-engagement.
Repeated opportunities, no benefit budget hidden by cherry-picking decisions.
stages.deliverable: Integrated online decision/release lifecycle with complete refusal and intervention logs.
stages.advance_rule: Physical closed-loop integrity passes before prospective efficacy evaluation.

stages.title: Prospective system efficacy and robustness
tests: Untouched audited seeds across 5-30% penetration and declared demand/traffic states.
Compare damping, report-rule escalation, feasibility-only escalation under a declared budget, and two-gate escalation.
Whole requested service, safety/smoothness outcomes, delayed harm, intervention count and seed-cluster uncertainty.
Reporting thinning with controllable membership held fixed; control thinning with observation access held fixed as a labeled diagnostic.
Registered delays, loss, sensor noise/occlusion and flow/IDM perturbations; measure performance and abstention, not invariance to genuine information loss.
stages.deliverable: Final paper figures and auditable prospective physical policy comparisons.
stages.advance_rule: Report measured effects and limitations without retuning on prospective outcomes. No universal congestion-prevention claim.

optional_multiwall_tests: Disjoint members/reserves and one writer per CAV
Inter-wall spacing, catch-up, storage and combined authority
Incremental benefit conditioned on another wall already being active
